The '''Mission to Tawntoom''' was a successful attempt to rescue [[Nilz Yomm|Nilz]] and [[Auren Yomm Baobab|Auren Yomm]] who were kidnapped and taken to [[Fortress of Tawntoom|the fortress]] in [[Tawntoom]] province. [[Gaff]] had taken Nilz to force him to treat [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Bisad Koong]] who had fallen ill to the [[Rooze Disease|Rooze disease]] while also taking Auren as insurance to ensure that [[Mungo Baobab]] did not attempt to follow them. But Baobab managed to find them both and secured their release before a series of events led to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] withdrawing from [[Roon/Legends|Roon]] and Koong succumbing to the disease while Baobab and his allies escaped onboard the ''[[Caravel (starship)|Caravel]]''.<ref name="TFC" />

==Background==
{{Quote|Your methods are too crude, Koong!''"<br />"''What does it matter, as long as the results are the same?|Terrinald Screed criticizes Bisad Koong for his unnecessary tactics|<ref name="TFC" />}}
[[File:Rooze.jpg|thumb|left|200px|The Rooze disease is spread across Umboo.]]
Following [[Skirmish on the Roon Sea|the skirmish]] in the [[Roon Sea]], [[Mungo Baobab]] and his droid companions [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] began preparing for their departure from [[Roon/Legends|Roon]] back to [[Manda/Legends|Manda]]. The three were taken by [[Nilz Yomm|Nilz]] and [[Auren Yomm Baobab|Auren Yomm]] to the [[Pinnacles of Felth]] to locate the [[Rainbow comet|Rainbow Comets]] in order to chart their path home. However, it was at this exact moment that [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Bisad Koong]], in an attempt to impress [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Terrinald Screed]], unleashed the [[Rooze Disease|Rooze disease]] upon the [[Umboo]] province to save face from his three previous failures ([[Skirmish on the New Umboo Lightstation|the lightstation]], [[Roon Colonial Games|the games]], and the Roon Sea). However, Koong accidentally infected himself in the process and sent his chief lieutenant [[Gaff]] to bring Nilz Yomm to him, since Yomm was the only healer on Roon capable of treating him.<ref name="TFC" />

Gaff visited the Yomm residence where Nilz was tending to his infected wife [[Bola Yomm|Bola]], and in an ensuing commotion, incapacitated Auren. He directed the two [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormstroopers]] with him to bring Nilz in addition to Auren as insurance that Baobab not try an attempt at mounting a rescue. However, before Auren could be taken away, Baobab planted half of his [[memling]] in Auren's belt as a way to find them.<ref name="TFC" />

==The rescue operation==
{{Quote|Why, sir, this is the memling your uncle Oggem gave you. But it seems smaller somehow.''"<br />"''It is smaller, I planted half of it on Auren before Gaff took her away. You see the way it's pointing? It'll lead us straight to it's other half, and Auren.|Mungo Baobab reveals his method for tracking Nilz and Auren Yomm to C-3PO|<ref name="TFC" />}}
[[File:MolecularDisruptor-TFC.png|thumb|right|200px|Baobab and C-3PO assess the molecular disruptor that shrunk R2-D2.]]
Onboard the [[cloudcraft]], Baobab was able to track the Yomm's to [[Fortress of Tawntoom|the fortress]] in [[Tawntoom]] using the memling like a compass. He tried to bring the ship through a shortcut into a [[Volcano/Legends|volcano]] but the ensuing [[Magma|lava]] forced them to crash into the snow on the cavern's other side. A second eruption saw an avalanche that sent R2-D2 crashing into a [[Mirror/Legends|mirror]] which was in actuality a [[molecular disruptor]] that dramatically shrunk the [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]].<ref name="TFC" />

Baobab and C-3PO then managed to subdue [[Unidentified alien merchants|two alien merchants]] with Baobab's [[seed launcher]] and stole their robes so as to distract the guards at the entrance while R2-D2 went through the ventilation shaft to locate the Yomm's. He managed to enter their room while narrowly avoiding a sleeping Gaff and a [[goorl]]. With their cell unlocked, Nilz attempted but failed to use the Rooze cure to incapacitate Gaff; but the attempt failed since a Kobak was immune to the Rooze disease.<ref name="TFC" />

[[File:SandSkimmer-Gaff.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Gaff corners Baobab and his allies.]]
Reunited with Baobab and C-3PO, the five try to board the ''[[Caravel (starship)|Caravel]]'', but are cornered by Gaff who arrives on a [[sandskimmer]] and alerts Screed and Koong. With the Yomm's safely aboard the ''Caravel'', Baobab and the droids hijack Koong's aerial drilling platform where Baobab issues an ultimatum: he will give up the cure and the location of the Roonstones in exchange for Umboo being left alone. However, when the Roonstones are uncovered, Screed betrays Koong, forcing the governor to take command of the drill and accidentally sending all the Roonstones into the volcano. In doing so, it froze the fortress's only heat source, which would freeze the entire citadel. While Screed and his forces flee and withdraw from the planet entirely, Baobab gives the cure to Koong before he and his allies flee. However, it is too late for Koong, who fades away and dies into nothingness, as the fortress freezes in ice.<ref name="TFC" />

==Aftermath==
The mission to the fortress ended Baobab's time on Roon, however, en route to Umboo, he discovers a single Roonstone inside R2-D2. Back at Umboo, the cure is successfully administered to Bola and other infected people, while Baobab instructs the droids to remain on Umboo until he returns from Manda to update his father on his progress on Roon.<ref name="TFC" />
